PhD Research Ongoing PhD Dissertation

Secrecy Capacity & Coding for Noisy Quantum Wiretap Channels

Doctoral research at UM6P College of Computing investigating information-theoretic security bounds, wiretap channel models, and code construction for transmitting secure classical information over noisy quantum channels.

  • Characterization of private classical capacity and quantum secrecy bounds
  • Degraded and non-degraded quantum wiretap channel mathematical models
Information Theory Quantum Information Wiretap Channel

Understanding Cryptography Solution Handbook

Comprehensive mathematical solutions and explanations for textbook exercises from 'Understanding Cryptography' by Paar & Pelzl. Covering symmetric ciphers, public-key algorithms, and finite field arithmetic.

  • Rigorous mathematical proofs for number theory and modular arithmetic
  • Detailed breakdown of AES, RSA, Diffie-Hellman, and Elliptic Curve Cryptography
